空调 26℃ 比 22℃ 能省多少电、减多少碳？

How much power and carbon does 26°C save versus 22°C on AC?

每调高 1℃ 约可省 7%–10% 的制冷电耗；从 22℃ 提到 26℃ 约省三成电，既舒服又明显减碳，还能缓减电网高峰压力。
Each degree higher saves roughly 7%–10% of cooling power; from 22°C to 26°C cuts about a third of the electricity—comfortable, lower carbon and easier on the grid peak.

选购家电看“能效标识”一级和三级，长期电费差多少？

Buying appliances, how much do tier-1 vs tier-3 energy labels differ in long-run electricity cost?

一级比三级通常省电 10%–30%，对冰箱、空调这种长年开机的大户，几年累计的电费差额常能抵回稍高的购机价，是全生命周期最划算的“隐性强减排”。
Tier-1 usually saves 10%–30% versus tier-3; for always-on fridges and AC, a few years of saved bills often repay the slightly higher price—a 'hidden, high-value' cut over the product's life.

#能效标识 #一级 #电费

家里最耗电的电器通常是哪些，怎么省？

Which home appliances usually use the most electricity, and how to save?

空调、电热水器、冰箱、洗衣机往往是用电大户。善用节能模式、夏季空调调高几度、热水器随用随开、冰箱不塞太满，能明显降电费。
AC, water heaters, fridges and washers are usually the biggest users. Eco modes, a few degrees higher AC in summer, on-demand heating and not overpacking the fridge cut bills noticeably.

#家电耗电 #节电 #节能模式

洗衣机能效和“冷水洗”对减碳的帮助？

How much do washer efficiency and 'cold wash' help cut carbon?

加热水是洗衣耗电大头，用冷水洗可省下约 80% 的洗衣能耗；选高能效机型、攒满再洗、自然晾干，能进一步压低碳足迹。
Heating water is most of a wash's power; cold washing can cut about 80% of that energy. Efficient models, full loads and air-drying lower the footprint further.

#洗衣机 #冷水洗 #能效

“待机能耗”是什么，为什么拔插头能省电？

What is 'standby power', and why does unplugging help?

电视、机顶盒、充电器关机后仍偷偷耗电，叫做“吸血鬼负载”。用带开关的插线板一键断电，长年累月能省下可观的电与碳。
TVs, set-top boxes and chargers still draw power when off—the 'vampire load'. A switched power strip cuts it all at once, saving real energy and carbon over time.

#待机能耗 #插头 #省电

随手关灯省的是发电厂的煤吗，为什么？

Does turning off lights save the power plant's coal, and why?

用电少，电厂就少烧煤少排碳。每盏灯看着小，全校、全城一起关，累计起来就是实打实的能源和蓝天。
Less electricity means the plant burns less coal and emits less carbon. One bulb is tiny, but a whole school or city switching off adds up to real energy and cleaner air.
